history_identity_proof.induction: Every next incoming is the previous outgoing in each archive; there is no interior reset.
history_identity_proof.derivatives: The fixed endpoints, offset, rate, N and Jacobian are independent of Z. Genuine C2 source functions on the conditional compact chart domain permit ordinary Z derivatives through the finite integrals twice.

math_api_description.finite_N_identity: With the same source functions, phase, N, and Pstar normalization, rho_C2 = N*rho_C5 componentwise, including the 1/N cross terms.
math_api_description.ordinary_Z: The source API carries ordinary spatial Z derivatives q = 0, 1, 2; q is not a temporal n recursion and no source values are numerically reduced.
math_api_description.history: At each micro, bridge, chart, postrestore, and patch port use H_after = memory*H_before + contribution with predecessor memory retained; the right-endpoint derivative contract is D_y H(right) = rho(right) - rate*H_out. At the patch inlet x=1, H(1)=H_in and D_y=x*partial_x.
math_api_description.physical_measure: The physical transport measure is dt/t (or the chart-equivalent source measure) with the physical Jacobian inserted exactly once.

finite_N_cross_terms.scaling: F=N*r, B=N*s, so every C2 cross term equals N times its C5 term.
